dct_description_sm: Kyrgyzstan administrative level 0-3 boundaries (COD-AB) dataset version 01. This dataset is structured into 3 levels: - Admin 1: 9 province, independent city [EN]; область, город [RU]; облусу, шаар [KY]) - Admin 2: 53 district [EN]; район, [RU]; району [KY], partial coverage - Admin 3: 737 community [EN]; айылный аймак [RU]; айыл аймаг [KY], partial coverage Dates associated with this dataset: - 31 January 2024: dataset reviewed for accuracy and completeness - 19 November 2018: valid for use by the humanitarian community - 21 November 2018: last edit to the dataset before publishing - 21 November 2018: boundaries created by the source Contributed by [OCHA Middle East and North Africa (ROMENA)](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-romena). Quality assured, configured, and published by [OCHA Field Information Services (FIS)](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-fiss) and [HDX](https://data.humdata.org/organization/hdx). Part of the dataset: [Global Subnational Administrative Boundaries](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-global)
dct_publisher_sm: Ministry of Emergency Situations of the Kyrgyz Republic
